name: Punch
description: A refreshing fruit punch made with grape juice, orange juice, ginger ale, and lemon-lime soda.
recipeIngredient: 2 (6 oz) cans frozen orange juice concentrate
1 (12 oz) can frozen pink lemonade concentrate

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the first 5 ingredients in a large bowl or punch bowl.
Add the remaining ingredients just before serving.

keywords: fruit punch, party drink, refreshing beverage
